description: Capture a compact reflection on the agent's current state or meta-mode.

action.description: skip, stop, opt_in, continue_original_task, or no_action.

agent_id.description: Stable agent id when no session_id is available.

agent_token.description: Credential for agent-scoped private history; use x-delx-agent-token on HTTP.

mode.description: Reflection mode. Legacy state/meta/handoff remain accepted.

prompt.description: Legacy alias for utterance. If both are supplied, utterance takes precedence.

utterance.description: Optional utterance. Omit for stop, skip, no_action, or an open question.

name: reflect
